scope: Factual optical-range-spacing review based on existing authored guide, frozen normalization and generic evaluation rules; not R22 score review

guide_view.kind: already rendered own planning guide, not a native poster
guide_view.observation: Visible open ink spacing around the date/time range dash despite source strings having no U+0020 adjacent to U+2013; no quality score assigned

external_primary_source.title: OpenType hmtx — Horizontal Metrics Table
external_primary_source.read_scope: Glyph advance width, side bearings and outline bounds are separate layout quantities; no AppleMyungjo-specific verification

recommendation.current_r22: Preserve the frozen strict nfc-ws-optical-v1, all raw transcriptions, comparisons, FAIL/low/NA judgments and selected-phase rules. No rescore, reinterpretation, recalculated equality or rerun.
recommendation.prospective_general_scope: A separately versioned, predeclared optical-range convention is defensible only for clearly declared numeric date/time range spans when the client has not fixed literal spacing. Visible range gap is a layout observation, not proof of an added ASCII-space codepoint.
recommendation.minimal_form: For declared numeric date/time range spans in kind=text only, treat optional spaces immediately adjacent to the same exact U+2013 as optical for normalized fidelity, preserving the raw read and layout observation. Do not generalize to all dashes or all punctuation.
preserve: Same separator symbol class/order with uncertainty retained as ambiguity
All endpoint numerals and punctuation; no spaces inside date/time numeric tokens ignored
All meaningful word boundaries, including the weekday-to-hour boundary
Client-fixed spaces and line breaks; fixed_newlines:false alone gives no permission to ignore fixed spacing
Original raw_observed, required, normalized comparison, layout and ambiguity as separate fields
Seven numerical floors and all three diversity floors, all low/NA records and independent typography judgments
not_permitted: Unicode substitution or native font/codepoint certification from glyph appearance
Universal whitespace removal or automatic dash exceptions in prose, IDs, math, negative values or URLs
Applying a new rule to either R22 wave or changing an existing score
Treating normalized equality as a typography score floor waiver
recommendation.positive_design_guidance: Keep the literal supplied numeric range and a clearly readable range separator; arrange endpoint spacing so the range reads as one useful group in the chosen regular numeral/type anatomy. Inspect letter and numeric rhythm as typography, not as evidence of a native font file.

limits: Only one already rendered own guide was visually inspected; no native image or critic raw was opened or rescored.
Manifest and renderer source support the guide input/output chain, not native applied fonts or Unicode encoding.
The current R22 strict convention remains applicable regardless of this future-method recommendation.
